name: threejs-animation
title_zh: 骨骼、变形、混合全包，GLTF 动画直接上手
tagline_zh: 骨骼、变形、关键帧、混合，GLTF 动画拿来即播。写代码前先问它，省得自己翻文档拼 API。
tagline_en: Keyframe, skeletal, morph, and mixing—play GLTF animations instantly. Ask before coding to skip API doc digging.
desc_en: Three.js animation - keyframe animation, skeletal animation, morph targets, animation mixing. Use when animating objects, playing GLTF animations, creating procedural motion, or blending animations.
why_zh: 它把官方示例拆成可复用的动作片段，按语义调用而非抄代码。你描述意图，它给出对应实现。
why_en: It turns official examples into reusable action snippets, invoked by intent rather than copy-paste. Describe what you want, get.
limit_zh: 仅覆盖 Three.js 动画模块，不含场景搭建、模型加载或渲染优化。超出此范围需自行处理，且要求环境已安装 Thre。
limit_en: Covers only Three.js animation APIs. No scene setup, model loading, or render optimization. Requires Three.js installed and GLTF assets present.
title_en: Keyframe, skeletal, morph, mixing—GLTF animation ready
